fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
verification_categories_derived_axi_base: Reset behavior (ARESETn, VALIDs LOW during reset).
Same-ID in-order completion / diff-ID out-of-order completion.
Default-signal substitution when optional fields omitted.
verification_categories_derived_ace: AxDOMAIN encoding coverage (Non-shareable / Inner / Outer / System).

ARSNOOP encoding coverage — all 12 valid encodings: ReadOnce / ReadNoSnoop / ReadShared / ReadClean / ReadNotSharedDirty / ReadUnique / CleanUnique / MakeUnique / CleanShared / CleanInvalid / MakeInvalid / DVMComplete / DVMMessage.
AWSNOOP encoding coverage — all 7 valid encodings: WriteNoSnoop / WriteUnique / WriteLineUnique / WriteClean / WriteBack / Evict / WriteEvict (with AWUNIQUE).
AxBAR barrier coverage — Normal / Memory Barrier / Synchronization Barrier across all 4 shareability domains.
Reserved AxSNOOP encodings rejected.
Illegal (AxDOMAIN, AxSNOOP, AxBAR) combinations rejected per Tables C3-7 / C3-8.
Snoop channel handshake (AC/CR/CD) — ACVALID/ACREADY then CRVALID; data path also CDVALID/CDREADY.
Snoop ordering — CR follows AC address order per master.
5-state cache-line transitions — Table C5-4 coverage for each (initial state, snoop type).
CRRESP PassDirty/IsShared/WasUnique/DataTransfer/Error correctness.
Illegal CRRESP combinations: IsShared=1 for ReadUnique/CleanInvalid/MakeInvalid; PassDirty=1 + DataTransfer=0.
RACK/WACK timing — exactly one ACLK cycle after corresponding final handshake; single-cycle pulse.
Snoop data bus width variation (32/64/128/256/512/1024 bits).
CD burst length must be 1/2/4/8/16; full cache-line writes use full bus width.
DVMMessage broadcast + DVMComplete aggregation timing.
Barrier transaction effect — no reordering across the barrier within named domain.
ACE-Lite subset — no AC/CR/CD; restricted to ReadOnce/ReadNoSnoop/WriteUnique/WriteLineUnique/WriteNoSnoop/Barrier.
AXI4 master integrated with ACE interconnect via Non-shareable tie-off.
Snoop filter consistency — Evict/WriteEvict updates snoop-filter state correctly.
Multi-master stress — concurrent ReadShared/ReadUnique/MakeUnique to overlapping lines; verify single-writer-eventually invariant.
Multi-master + dirty-line race — only one cached master can hold PassDirty responsibility at any time.
interoperability_test_matrix: ACE-Lite master + ACE interconnect (snoop port absent).
AXI4 master + ACE interconnect at AxDOMAIN=Non-shareable.
Mixed cluster: ACE + ACE-Lite + AXI4 + DVM-capable masters in one interconnect.
Snoop-data bus narrower than RDATA/WDATA — beat count adjustment.
Multi-domain barriers — Inner vs Outer vs System scoping.
Snoop filter ON vs OFF — Evict / WriteEvict required only when ON.
fields.notes: IHI 0022E does not provide a formal verification plan; the categories above are derived from Chapters C3 (Channel Signaling), C4 (Coherent Transactions), C5 (Snoop Transactions), C8 (Barrier Transactions), C9 (Additional Considerations / RACK/WACK), C12 (DVM).
